feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: After midterm losses, Trump makes changes to his inner circle
entry.summary: President Trump is shaking up his closest advisers after Democrats made huge gains in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Trump appoints Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff
entry.summary: The president selected Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff. NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Miles Taylor, a former Department of Homeland Security chief of staff who worked with Miller.

entry.title: U.N. climate talks begin today. Here are 3 things to know
entry.summary: Countries are gathering in Antalya, Turkey, for the annual U.N. climate conference. Many are frustrated with the lack of focus on fossil fuels, the main driver of climate change.

entry.title: Supreme Court weighs effort to shield federal law enforcement as ICE complaints rise
entry.summary: The Supreme Court considers the case of a prisoner who suffered brutal injuries, only to be denied medical care behind bars. He wants to sue the prison nurse in a case that could change the law on holding federal officers accountable.

entry.title: Congress is coming back to Washington. Here's what to expect
entry.summary: Lawmakers are coming back to Washington this week after the midterm elections. Republicans plan to finish work on several outstanding issues before Democrats take control of Congress in January.

entry.title: Palantir hires a former Democratic senator as it faces scrutiny in new Congress
entry.summary: The secretive software company has been accused of letting its powerful tools be used by the Trump administration to surveil Americans. Now it's hiring former Sen. Jon Tester to burnish its image.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump shakes up his staff after midterm losses, Congress returns to Washington, Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's alleged relationship with Chinese spy.

entry.title: In 'Gentle Monster,' a pervert's normality is the horrifying factor
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Léa Seydoux about her new film Gentle Monster, in which she plays a concert pianist whose life falls apart after her husband is accused of a crime.

entry.title: Israel's president taps Netanyahu's political rival to form a new government
entry.summary: Israel's president has tapped Benjamin Netanyahu's chief political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, to form a new government following an inconclusive election that left the country's leadership in limbo.

entry.title: Midterm results could complicate JD Vance's political future
entry.summary: Vice President JD Vance is looking to recast his political fortune after serving as the Trump administration's No. 2 while his party suffered a historic wipeout.
